claim_boundary: The selector is existential and recomputes a Hall blocker after each move. Finite-corpus coverage is not a universal lemma, does not prove the row-merge continuation claim, and does not prove complete additive EFX.
domain: frozen exact integer models in one generic q=4 row-merge cell
interpretation: This is exact finite-trace evidence for an adaptive Hall-guided exchange mechanism. Coverage means every frozen generic adversarial valuation has at least one such path of at most three transfers.
move_rule: At an unmatched labeled partition, choose an inclusion-minimal Hall-deficient agent set whose neighborhood omits the current hole; move one good from a non-singleton bundle in that neighborhood into the hole, then make the source the new hole. Sources are distinct, and the initial hole is never used as a source.
